Tyre reorder

Click a size for the full study. set=buy in 4s · pair=combination (2s) · ord=buy to order · red=urgent (key tier empty).
SizeCatFloor/yrHand T1T2T3T4 Buy now
Keep target = a set of 4 (combinations: 2) + this month's demand, rounded to whole sets. Buy = the gap to that target — so a fresh order is always a full set, and 1–3 only appears as a same-brand top-up. Targets taper into year-end clearance (Jan T3/T4, Feb T1/T2).

Stock clearance

Discount old stock before it loses value. Prices update live as you change the structure below, then send the list to the team.
In Q4, floors taper down and you buy only what sells by Dec 31 — for fast movers, taper in small next-year quantities so old stock clears first.

Cash & cover

How much cash is tied up in tyre stock and how long it covers demand. Anything beyond ~3 months (your 90-day credit window) is cash you owe the supplier before you've earned it back. Dead = nothing sold here in the last 6 months. Tap ▸ to see the exact item codes; the Clearance column shows if it's already being actioned.

Set completion

Brands sitting below a full set of 4 — odd lots that won't sell as a set. Complete each to 4 in the same brand: move stock from another branch when the loose pieces add up, otherwise order the gap.

Understocked sizes

Sizes that hit zero stock during months they were still selling — the clearest sign of demand you couldn't serve. Estimated lost units = months out × average monthly demand. Click a size for its monthly chart.
SizeCat/yrMonths at zero (selling)Est. lost units
Built from the exact monthly stock reconstruction (purchases − sales − returns, anchored to today's verified count).

4x4 patterns

Like Tyre reorder, but for 4x4. Each size shows its A/T vs H/T mix — click a size to see, per tier, which pattern actually moves and whether to stock both. H/T=highway · A/T=all-terrain · ?=untagged (tap a tag inside to set it).

Trial sizes — predicted demand

Sizes this branch isn’t selling yet that the data suggests could move. Add pushes a conservative 4-pc trial into Tyre reorder (tagged TRIAL) and Supplier orders — you approve each one and set its tier. Two evidence sources, kept separate.

Battery reorder

Batteries grouped by size — all brands of a size pooled. Per-quarter min/max reorder: pick a quarter, keep each size between its Min (default 1) and Max (peaks Q2–Q3). Click a size to see the brands and adjust.
SizeBrandsReorder → KeepHandBuy nowAdjust

Apex reorder

Apex accessories (valves, reels, chucks, kits). Per-quarter min/max reorder — pick a quarter below, then keep each stocked item between its Min (default 1) and Max (set by that quarter's season; Apex peaks Q4–Q1). Buy-to-order items show "—". Grouped into product families; ✎ marks bands you've tuned. Click a row to view or adjust.

Supplier orders

Your tyre buy plan for , sourced by tier — each supplier's brand sets its tier. By tier compares every supplier per size so you buy the cheapest; By supplier shows one supplier's order with the next-best price beside each line for bargaining.
Net price = list price after the supplier's discount. Sizes no supplier lists at the needed tier appear under "No tier-matched supplier". Batteries and Apex use different suppliers.

Settings

The editable lists and dials behind the dashboard. Changes here save online and apply to every branch / every viewer.

Every manual override you make is logged here — what the model predicted vs what you chose, and which month. Shows where your judgement consistently differs from the prediction, so we can tune the forecast. You decide when to bake a correction in; nothing changes the model automatically.
